_provenance.note: Real response subset from the ErlyLine/Betinvest JSON-RPC gateway, captured live on 2026-09-27. The gateway is POST /service/lineout/frontend_api2/ and returns a single envelope. The full body is ~9.8 MB; it is pruned to the market rows the kept events were built from, because that is not a size to commit. Kickoff times, prices and ids are the real ones — nothing is reshaped.
_provenance.note2: `expected` deliberately includes one synthetic totals pool ("Goluri Gazde (N Meciuri) v Goluri Oaspeti"), which the adapter publishes as a football fixture carrying a MATCH_ODDS market. That is a real defect; the test pins it rather than hiding it.
